audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was 'Skill' in both layers while whys[0] and early both said 'Level 1 is yours'. Level 2 was given to Volibear against the packet and the mirror, and the 2-item row was 'Skill' while whys[6] said Warwick out-scales.
audit.why: Thundering Smash is a 12s stun at rank 1 and he does not have it at level 1, so the opening trade is Warwick's; by two items Warwick's lifesteal and R lockdown beat a front-to-back diver.
audit.corrected: Row 0 to Warwick, row 1 to Skill, row 6 to Warwick — matched full/content pairs with ratings moved to 7/10, 5/10 and 6/10, and phases[0].why re-keyed to the missing stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three places (spikes[1].text, spikes[2].text, whys[4]) credited Stormbringer with a shield and an 'unstoppable / near-unstoppable dash'.
audit.why: Riot's description of Stormbringer says he leaps, slows and damages beneath him, and gains bonus HEALTH, and that nearby enemy towers are disabled. The shield in his kit belongs to Sky Splitter (E, 16s flat) and only when he stands inside his own blast radius. Nothing in the text grants unstoppable. Stormbringer is also 160/135/110 — the longest cooldown in the matchup and the real punish window.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, spikes[2].text, whys[4] and mid rewritten to bonus health plus tower disable, with the shield attributed to Sky Splitter and the 160s rank-1 cooldown stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: The do's and don'ts never said what Thundering Smash does to Infinite Duress, and Frenzied Maul's cooldown and second-cast heal were never quantified.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is a channelled leap-and-suppress, so hard CC on Warwick cuts it. Thundering Smash (Q, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) stuns the first enemy he attacks after closing and resets that attack — it is the one button that answers your ultimate, so a good Volibear holds it for your leap rather than opening with it. Frenzied Maul (W) is a flat 5s and heals him on the second cast against the same marked target, which is why extended trades go his way.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d and dosFull[1].d now state the stun cancelling the channel and the bait; dontsFull[0].d states the first-target-only stun and auto reset; dontsFull[1].d states Frenzied Maul's 5s cooldown and second-cast heal.

edits.before: Your passive sustain wins extended level-1 auto wars. Identify how Volibear contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours before Thundering Smash exists — his stun is 12s at rank 1 and he cannot lock a trade down until he has it.

edits.before: His engage. Bait it before R. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Thundering Smash is a 12s stun at rank 1 and it cancels your R channel.

edits.before: Q-bite Volibear as he steps up (hold Q to follow his dash), weave autos, and let the passive out-heal his return damage.
edits.after: He saves Thundering Smash for your leap, so move erratically and make him throw it early — a stunned Warwick loses the suppress.

edits.before: That is Volibear's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: His Q stuns only the first enemy he attacks after closing, and it resets his auto.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Frenzied Maul is a 5s cooldown and its second cast heals him.

edits.before: At 6 Stormbringer's shield, unstoppable dash, and tower disable beat your all-in.
edits.after: At 6 Stormbringer's bonus health, leap, and tower disable beat your all-in.

edits.before: Stormbringer (R) makes him near-unstoppable, shields him, and disables your towers; never all-in with Infinite Duress into his up R, and respect that he wins the extended fight through his W sustain.
edits.after: Stormbringer (R) is a 160s leap granting bonus health and disabling your towers — the shield is Sky Splitter (E, 16s), not his ult; never commit Infinite Duress into an up R and his W sustain.

edits.before: Volibear's bruiser spike with W heal and R shield out-sustains your damage in a straight duel, so keep farming safely and defer to jungle collapses rather than soloing him.
edits.after: Volibear's bruiser spike with Frenzied Maul heals and Sky Splitter's shield out-sustains your damage in a duel, so farm safely and defer to jungle collapses rather than soloing him.

edits.before: Levels 3 through 6 belong to Volibear: his W sustain out-heals your trades and Stormbringer at 6 gives a shield, near-unstoppable dash, and tower disable that beats your Infinite Duress all-in. Don't commit R into his up ultimate; farm safe and wait for your jungler.
edits.after: Levels 3 through 6 belong to Volibear: his W sustain out-heals your trades and Stormbringer at 6 is a 160s leap with bonus health and a tower disable that beats your all-in. The shield is Sky Splitter, 16s — don't commit R into an up ultimate; farm safe and wait for your jungler.

notes: Three separate fields gave Stormbringer a shield and called it unstoppable. Riot's text grants bonus health and a tower disable; the shield is Sky Splitter and only when he stands in his own blast. A player told his ult shields him will mistime every all-in. Also flagged by the mirror and true from this side: Thundering Smash, not Sky Splitter, is the stun that cuts the Infinite Duress channel.
